description: This file defines a static class 'CosmosIdSanitizer' that provides methods to sanitize and unsanitize strings for use as identifiers in Cosmos DB, handling special characters with escape sequences. It also contains conditional compilation directives to set the namespace based on different Orleans features.

classes.name: CosmosIdSanitizer
classes.description: A static utility class for sanitizing and unsanitizing strings for Cosmos DB identifiers.

methods.name: Sanitize
methods.description: Replaces special characters in the input string with escape sequences to make it safe for Cosmos DB identifiers.

methods.name: Unsanitize
methods.description: Reverts escape sequences in the input string back to their original characters.
